context.text: Portal esportivo de alto tráfego. Front em Next.js, conteúdo em WordPress headless, infraestrutura em AWS e Cloudflare.

en.title: Lance!

context.text: High-traffic sports portal. Next.js front end, headless WordPress for content, infrastructure on AWS and Cloudflare.

work.text: I work on keeping it running: Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, observability, incident response with root cause analysis, and CI/CD with rollback.
